title: Mughal Empire
summary: A Muslim dominion in India lasting from 1526 to 1857, founded by Babur. Shah Jahan moved the capital to Delhi, where the Red Fort was built as the palace fort of his new capital, Shahjahanabad. By the time of the 1857 uprising the empire had shrunk to a small area around Delhi.

uncertainty.note: Dates as given by Oxford dictionary text republished on Encyclopedia.com.

as_recorded.value: The Mughal Empire was founded in 1526

where.modern_name: Red Fort, Delhi, India (capital pinned: Shahjahanabad, the capital Shah Jahan moved to; earlier seats are not pinned)
where.historical_name: Shahjahanabad (Delhi), new capital of the fifth Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan

importance.justification: The Muslim dominion that ruled much of India for over three centuries, from Babur to the 1857 uprising.

reviewer_note: Capital choice: the sources name Delhi (Shah Jahan moved the capital there); Akbar-era and earlier seats are not stated on the opened pages, so none is pinned. Date of Shah Jahan's move not given. Peak extent not covered.
